mitigation: Keep the affected API in an isolated lab until server-side policy-write guards pass retest.
corrective_action: Require verified identity and server-side role checks on policy creation/version routes. Restrict approval to administrators.
closure: Signed Employee and Owner approval attempts denied without writes; administrator approval succeeds; anonymous policy writes denied.

mitigation: Review and update the affected trust bundle before depending on it for sensitive client traffic.
corrective_action: Upgrade the local certifi bundle to a reviewed fixed release (registry recommends 2026.10.19 or later), then verify which application clients use it. Preserve TLS validation.
closure: Installed version no longer matches the advisory; verify the deployed trust bundle and rerun affected client tests. No on-path interception test is required.

mitigation: Treat feed links as unverified attribution until source-specific host enforcement passes.
corrective_action: Bind article URLs to approved publisher hosts and validate redirects before following them.
closure: Unrelated hosts rejected; official publishers and expected GovDelivery tenant accepted; regression and current feed checks pass.

mitigation: Retain installed-version snapshot and require review of dependency changes pending a tested lock.
corrective_action: Create a reviewed version/hash lock and deployed SBOM, then perform advisory triage.
closure: Clean reproducible install from reviewed lock, dependency consistency check and documented advisory dispositions.

mitigation: Use approved indexes only and schedule tooling upgrade; avoid untrusted-index downloads.
corrective_action: Upgrade pip to a reviewed fixed release 26.2.0 or later and restrict installs/downloads to approved indexes.
closure: Requery the installed pip release, verify advisory no longer applies, and validate approved-index package installation in an isolated environment.
